description: Prepare an exchange for the user to finish on simpleswap.io: check the parameters and get a link to the SimpleSwap exchange form with the pair, networks, amount and rate type filled in. Safe to call: it creates no exchange, reserves no rate and has no side effects. When canCreate is true, show exchangeFormUrl to the user: they enter and confirm the receiving address on the site. amount is always the amount the user sends; to start from the amount the user receives, get the amount to send with simpleswap_get_estimate first. The rate and availability can change before the user opens the link. When canCreate is false there is no link, and reason explains why: tell the user.

amount.description: Amount the user sends as a positive decimal, e.g. "0.2".

fixed.description: true for fixed-rate, false for floating-rate (default).

networkFrom.description: Network of the currency the user sends, e.g. "btc".

networkTo.description: Network of the currency the user receives, e.g. "eth".

tickerFrom.description: Ticker of the currency the user sends, e.g. "btc".

tickerTo.description: Ticker of the currency the user receives, e.g. "eth".

name: simpleswap_prepare_exchange

exchangeFormUrl.description: Exchange form on simpleswap.io with the pair, networks, rate type and amount (as the amount sent) filled in; only when canCreate is true. Show it to the user.

reason.description: Why the exchange cannot be created; only when canCreate is false.

title: Prepare exchange
